action: No action needed; for awareness. Fraud and compliance teams can expect a direct channel to law enforcement for scam-linked accounts, domains and wallets.
date_note: The Homeland Security Task Force press release is dated 18 November; The Record's article is dated 19 November.
exec: A new US federal unit aims to freeze scam payments and take down scam infrastructure faster, with private-sector partners able to act on shared intelligence.
org: US Department of Justice and Department of Homeland Security
plain: The US Homeland Security Task Force, with DHS and DOJ, has launched a Threat Disruption Center to triage victim complaints, map criminal networks and share intelligence with private companies.
summary: The Homeland Security Task Force announced a Threat Disruption Center inside its National Coordination Center, co-led by DHS and DOJ. The release says it will triage victim complaints, map criminal networks and share intelligence with private partners in near real time, with TRM Labs as primary private-sector partner. It cites losses reported to the FBI's IC3 of $20.9 billion in 2025.
title: DOJ and DHS launch Threat Disruption Center against scams and cybercrime

validation.note: HSTF press release (18 Nov) and Malwarebytes read; The Record reports the same launch.

review.note: Checked HSTF release (18 Nov), Malwarebytes, The Record: date, TRM role, near-real-time sharing and the 20.9 billion IC3 figure match. Plain said overseas scam networks that target Americans, which no source read states; rewritten from the summary.
